steps: Rinse the rice and moong dal together three times, soak them for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker, add the cumin, and when it sizzles add the asafoetida.
Add the chopped onion and cook until soft and see-through.
Add the tomato, ginger, green chilli and turmeric and cook until the tomato softens.
Add the drained rice and dal and stir for a minute.
Pour in water, about three and a half cups for two people, and add the salt.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles, then let the pressure drop on its own.
Stir well, loosen with hot water if it is too thick, and serve with a little ghee on top.
note: Two recipes used half a cup each of rice and dal for two people and one stretched it to three; this keeps 50 g of each a person, since khichdi is the whole meal. Ghee includes a spoon to drizzle on top.
